# DimeStack

> DimeStack is a personal finance tracker for households and freelancers. It keeps multiple ledgers, transactions, budgets, goals, and net worth.

DimeStack is a web app for keeping personal ledgers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dimestack.app/): Product overview, charts, and how a ledger works
- [About](https://dimestack.app/about): What the tracker keeps and how the ledger is organized
- [Privacy](https://dimestack.app/privacy): Cookies, sessions, email, and campaign parameters
- [Security](https://dimestack.app/security): Password hashing, email verification, sessions, and request limits
- [Search](https://dimestack.app/search): Search public pages and signed-in records
- [Log in](https://dimestack.app/login): Email or Google sign-in
- [Create account](https://dimestack.app/register): Open a ledger

Signed-in tools (dashboard, transactions, budgets, recurring items, goals, net worth, reports, categories, profile, and sessions) live under /app and are not indexed.

## Records you can keep

- Several ledgers, each with its own accounts
- Income, expenses, and transfers between accounts
- Categories and subcategories
- Monthly budgets and recurring transactions
- Savings goals and net worth (assets minus liabilities)
- CSV import and export, plus a PDF report
